messages.subject: Copyrights ??
parts:
Pleas run this app and tell me why it always print the "copyrights" and how to remove them :)


#install.packages("shiny")
#install.packages("rgl")
#install.packages("shinyRGL")
#
#######################################################################################
library(shiny)
library(rgl)
library(shinyRGL)
#######################################################################################
ui <- fluidPage(

textInput(inputId = "strike", label = "Strike", value = "", width = "30%"),

textInput(inputId = "dip", label = "Dip", value = "", width = "30%"),

actionButton(inputId = "add", label = "Add a plane"),

actionButton(inputId = "plotwebGL", label = "Update"),

webGLOutput(outputId = "plotwebGL"),

verbatimTextOutput(outputId = "log_planes"),

data_planes <- data.frame(),
makeReactiveBinding("data_planes")




)
#######################################################################################
server <- function(input, output) {
  
observe({
    input$add
    isolate({
      data_planes <<- rbind(data_planes, data.frame(input$strike, input$dip))
   
       })
  })  
  
  
#observe({
   output$plotwebGL <- renderWebGL({
    dat <- replicate(2, 1:3)
    plot3d(dat, type = 'n', xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1), zlim = c(-3, 3), xlab = '', ylab = '', zlab = '')  # plot 3D cube
    planes3d(1, 1, 1, 0, col = 'red', alpha = 0.6)
    planes3d(1, -1, 1, 0, col = 'orange', alpha = 0.6)
    planes3d(1, -1, -1, -0.8, col = 'blue', alpha = 0.6)
    
    }, width = "auto")
#  })


output$log_planes <- renderPrint({print(data_planes)})


}
#######################################################################################
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
